chapter.title: Family Discount
chapter.subtitle: The uncle joke lands. Then the hands do.
chapter.description: The uncle joke lands. Then the hands do. Watch the film, work the shift, solve the House puzzle, and win a fade against the red and blue crews.

tips: RED PUNCH can only enter the right district and takes Hands from other cards there.
Develop two useful districts instead of filling every slot early.
The cook you earn retaliates against ability damage to another ally in its district.
Round 1: Squabble House cook joins your hand. Round 2: Squabble House Manager joins your hand. These are temporary copies for this battle; pay their normal Motion costs to play them.

scenes.speaker: Blue OG
scenes.text: You throwing hands with a reservation?

scenes.speaker: Manager
scenes.text: Dogs stay by the booth. Everybody else stops rearranging my furniture.

scenes.speaker: Cuff
scenes.text: I can separate Red and Blue. Five seats. One rule: they do not get the ends wrong.

scenes.speaker: tek-KEN
scenes.text: Give me a seat where Red can see the bill. He keeps discovering new reading problems.

scenes.speaker: Cuff
scenes.text: Face the booth. Your left is the left end. Read everybody’s request, then seat all five.

scenes.speaker: Manager
scenes.text: I am taking the middle. This establishment has enough divided opinions.

puzzle.title: A Booth Apart
puzzle.instruction: Seat the five people left to right as you face the booth. One person per seat. Use every person once and satisfy every seating request. Left and right refer to the screen, not the diners’ hands.

pieces.label: Blue
pieces.detail: Sits at the opposite end from Red, somewhere to Red’s right.

pieces.label: Manager
pieces.detail: Takes the middle seat: seat 3 of 5.

pieces.label: tek-KEN
pieces.detail: Sits immediately to Red’s right so Red can read the bill.

hints: Red occupies an end and Blue must be to his right. That rules out Red’s right-hand end.
Red is seat 1, Blue seat 5, Manager seat 3. tek-KEN belongs immediately after Red; Cuff fills seat 4.
puzzle.solvedText: Red • tek-KEN • Manager • Cuff • Blue. Both sides of The Opps can see the receipts without reaching each other. Their OGs, unfortunately, are still standing.
puzzle.skipText: Let the crew explain the solution. The next fade still has to be won to earn its reward.

preDialogue.text: Blood crew handles the family business. You want my seat? Earn it.

preDialogue.speaker: Griddle
preDialogue.text: RED PUNCH controls the right district and takes Hands from everyone there. Spread your crew before his reveal.

postDialogue.speaker: Red OG

scenes.speaker: Cuff
scenes.text: Seats fixed. Plate safe. Why is that shadow getting bigger?
